product_summary: Manufacturer of contract/upholstery fabrics for workplace, hospitality, auditorium and residential interiors. Own portfolio (per responsefabrics.com): Crepes, Poly recycled cotton, Mesh, polyester 'Leatherite' (artificial leather), Jacquard, Jute, Knitted, Printed and PP spun-bond non-woven fabrics; plus acoustic pod/panel fabrics and custom print fabrics. Plant address: A2, Sector 21, Meerut Road Industrial Area, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201010. ISO 9001 certified, 'Made in India'. Source: https://www.responsefabrics.com/ and https://www.responsefabrics.com/contact-us/
comment: HS 5407.52 (dyed woven synthetic filament fabric) is CORRECT and matches the core upholstery/workstation fabric line — partial match confirmed. HS 6901.00 (bricks/blocks of siliceous earths — i.e. ceramic building material) is WRONG: nothing on the company's site or catalogue relates to refractory/ceramic bricks; this looks like a data-entry or declaration error and must be replaced with the actual textile codes. Corrected/expanded code set: 5407.52, 5407.61/69, 5515.11-19, 6005/6006 (knitted), 5903.20/5903.90 or 3921.12/3921.90 (Leatherite artificial leather), 5603.11-14 (PP spun-bond non-woven), 5310.10/90 (jute), 4911/5909 (printed). Industry misclassification: declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is WRONG — the company is a TEXTILE manufacturer (Ch. 54/55/56/58/59/60/63), not food. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection: company is retained, code corrected, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product lines above are taken from the company's own website/catalogue and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was available in this task to corroborate any specific code. Trader signs: none observed — the site describes own manufacturing (ISO 9001 certified plant, 'we make the fabric'), so manufacturer role is indicated, though no factory/export documentation was reviewed here. No registry, revenue or shipment research performed per role scope.
